correctness.rationale: Independent cluster minima and independent argmin identity give Bernoulli core candidates and a uniform relative minimum order. The core acceptance decisions coincide pathwise with greedy on the candidate-induced core. Within-cluster private-label permutations prove uniform independent private selections conditional on the core output. A no-core comparison proves iff uniformity; complete-core probabilities and total variation follow by exact counting. The packaged exact verifier exhausts 887040 permutations over six test graphs; universality rests on the proof.

value.rationale: An entire exact terminal-set distribution is reduced from an arbitrary clique corona to a Bernoulli-induced core process, yielding a nontrivial uniformity iff for every core and private-clique size and a closed sharp total-variation expression on connected complete-core coronas. This answers a natural distributional and bias question, rather than merely evaluating an arbitrary small case. The theorem has a stated exponential-evaluation limitation.
